verdict.rationale: Portfolio-level reporting is a fair question for a work-management tool like Trello, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack documents no cross-board or cross-project rollup view. The only nearby items are adjacent: tracking task progress "in one convenient place" (a single board layout), card mirroring and linking, and Power-Ups that a developer could build into a custom view. None of these is a documented portfolio view that aggregates progress across multiple projects.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can roll up progress across multiple projects into a single portfolio view
